title: Bump/arena allocator
description: Allocate by bumping a pointer; free everything at once by resetting — the fastest allocator there is. Allocations per operation: 0 (amortized). Core idea: bump pointer, reset en masse. Example: per-request arenas in servers.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Object pools
description: Recycle fixed-size objects instead of malloc/free; kills fragmentation in hot loops. Allocations per operation: 0 after warmup. Core idea: free-list recycling. Example: connection pools, particle systems.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Ring buffers
description: A fixed array with head/tail indices; the classic lock-free SPSC queue with zero allocation. Allocations per operation: 0. Core idea: circular fixed array. Example: audio pipelines, log shipping.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Intrusive linked lists
description: Links live inside the objects (like Linux list_head) so nodes never allocate separately. Allocations per operation: 0. Core idea: embedding next/prev in payload. Example: Linux kernel lists.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Small Vector Optimization
description: Vectors store small counts inline (LLVM SmallVector, folly small_vector) avoiding heap for the common case. Allocations per operation: 0 when small. Core idea: inline buffer + spill. Example: compiler IR operand lists.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Slab allocators
description: Pre-carved slabs for fixed sizes; the kernel’s answer to fragmentation. Allocations per operation: 0 (from slab). Core idea: size-classed caches. Example: Linux SLAB/SLUB.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: FlatBuffers
description: Zero-copy serialization: read structs directly from the wire buffer with no parse step. Allocations per operation: 0 on read. Core idea: aligned in-place layout. Example: game networking, mobile.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Unrolled linked lists
description: Nodes hold arrays of elements, cutting pointer overhead and allocations per element. Allocations per operation: 1 per N elements. Core idea: chunked nodes. Example: text editors (ropes’ cousin).
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: MPMC lock-free queues
description: Michael-Scott queues move items between threads with CAS and preallocated nodes. Allocations per operation: 0 steady-state. Core idea: CAS + node recycling. Example: thread-pool work queues.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Memory-mapped files
description: Map files into address space; the OS pages data with zero user-space copies. Allocations per operation: 0. Core idea: OS page cache as storage. Example: databases (LMDB).
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Stack allocation
description: alloca and stack arrays vanish on return — the original zero-allocator. Allocations per operation: 0. Core idea: frame-lifetime storage. Example: small temp buffers.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Copy-on-write buffers
description: Share pages until someone writes; fork() and Btrfs snapshots ride this. Allocations per operation: 0 until write. Core idea: shared pages, fault on write. Example: process fork, snapshots.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Rope structures
description: Trees of string chunks give O(log n) edits without reallocating whole texts. Allocations per operation: O(log n) nodes. Core idea: balanced chunk tree. Example: editors (Xi, Sublime).
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Static arrays with cursors
description: Fixed arrays plus a length cursor replace dynamic vectors in embedded code. Allocations per operation: 0. Core idea: fixed cap + cursor. Example: firmware buffers.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Bit-packed flags
description: Pack booleans into bitfields; 64 flags fit in one register with zero indirection. Allocations per operation: 0. Core idea: bit-level packing. Example: entity component flags.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.
